ApplyScalingGroup.title: ApplyScalingGroup
ApplyScalingGroup.summary: Creates and manages ECI-based scaling groups by using a configuration file. You can call the ApplyScalingGroup operation to implement this feature.

AttachAlbServerGroups.title: Add one or more ALB server groups
AttachAlbServerGroups.summary: Adds one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups to a scaling group.

AttachDBInstances.title: Add one or more apsaraDB RDS instances
AttachDBInstances.summary: Adds one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances.

AttachInstances.title: Manually add ECS instances to a scaling group
AttachInstances.summary: Manually adds ECS instances to a scaling group.

AttachLoadBalancers.title: Add one or more load balancing instances
AttachLoadBalancers.summary: Adds one or more load balancing instances.

AttachServerGroups.title: Add one or more load balancing server groups
AttachServerGroups.summary: Adds one or more load balancing server groups to a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB).

AttachVServerGroups.title: AttachVServerGroups
AttachVServerGroups.summary: Adds one or more virtual service groups under a load balancing instance.

CancelInstanceRefresh.title: CancelInstanceRefresh
CancelInstanceRefresh.summary: Cancels an instance refresh task. Instances that have already been replaced or added during scale-out are retained.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: Change the resource group of a scaling group
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Adds a scaling group as a resource to a resource group.

CompleteLifecycleAction.title: Complete the wait state of a scaling activity ahead of schedule
CompleteLifecycleAction.summary: Completes the wait state of a scaling activity ahead of schedule.

CreateEciScalingConfiguration.title: Create a scaling configuration
CreateEciScalingConfiguration.summary: Creates a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type.

CreateLifecycleHook.title: Create one or more lifecycle hooks for a scaling group
CreateLifecycleHook.summary: Creates one or more lifecycle hooks for a scaling group.

CreateNotificationConfiguration.title: Create Auto Scaling event and resource change notifications
CreateNotificationConfiguration.summary: Creates auto scaling event and resource change notifications.

CreateScalingConfiguration.title: CreateScalingConfiguration
CreateScalingConfiguration.summary: Creates an ECS-type scaling configuration for a scaling group by calling the CreateScalingConfiguration operation with the scaling group ID, instance type, instance image, and other information specified.

CreateScalingGroup.title: CreateScalingGroup
CreateScalingGroup.summary: Creates a scaling group to automatically adjust your compute capacity (the number of instances) based on business changes and policies.

DeleteEciScalingConfiguration.title: Delete a scaling configuration
DeleteEciScalingConfiguration.summary: Deletes a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type.

DeleteNotificationConfiguration.title: Delete an auto scaling event and resource change notification
DeleteNotificationConfiguration.summary: Deletes an auto scaling event and resource change notification.

DescribeAlertConfiguration.title: DescribeAlertConfiguration
DescribeAlertConfiguration.summary: When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications through SMS or email. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the DescribeAlertConfiguration operation to query the scaling activity statuses for which SMS and email notifications are sent in a scaling group. This helps you stay informed about changes to scaling activities and respond quickly to improve scaling efficiency.

DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.title: Query scaling configuration information
DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.summary: Queries scaling configurations of the ECI type.

DescribeElasticStrength.title: Query elastic strength of a scaling group
DescribeElasticStrength.summary: The validity of a scaling group configuration largely determines the success rate of scale-out operations. Auto Scaling uses elastic strength to describe the validity of scaling configurations, quantifying configuration quality and helping you optimize scaling configurations accordingly.

DescribeInstanceRefreshes.title: DescribeInstanceRefreshes
DescribeInstanceRefreshes.summary: Queries instance refresh tasks for a scaling group, including basic information and progress of each task.

DescribeLifecycleActions.title: Query lifecycle tokens
DescribeLifecycleActions.summary: Queries lifecycle tokens by scaling activity ID and status.

DescribeNotificationConfigurations.title: Query auto scaling events and resource change notifications
DescribeNotificationConfigurations.summary: Queries the auto scaling events and resource change notifications that you created.

DescribeNotificationTypes.title: Query types of Auto Scaling events and resource change notifications
DescribeNotificationTypes.summary: Queries the types of Auto Scaling events and resource change notifications.

DescribePatternTypes.title: DescribePatternTypes
DescribePatternTypes.summary: When configuring scaling configurations using the instance attribute-based method, call the DescribePatternTypes API to filter eligible instance types based on specified instance attributes such as the number of vCPU cores, memory size, instance family level, and the maximum acceptable price.

DescribeRegions.title: Query regions where Auto Scaling is available
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions where Auto Scaling is available.

DescribeScalingActivityDetail.title: Query the details of a scaling activity
DescribeScalingActivityDetail.summary: Queries the details of a scaling activity.

DescribeScalingConfigurations.title: DescribeScalingConfigurations
DescribeScalingConfigurations.summary: Queries information about ECS-type scaling configurations, including instance types and images, so that you can learn about the ECS instance templates used for scale-out activities in advance.

DescribeScalingInstances.title: Query instances in a scaling group
DescribeScalingInstances.summary: Queries the list of ECS instances in a scaling group and their information by scaling group ID, including the total number of running spot instances, total number of ECS instances, warmup state of ECS instances, and lifecycle state. You can also filter ECS instances by health check status, lifecycle state, or creation type.

DescribeScalingRules.title: Query scaling rules
DescribeScalingRules.summary: Queries the scaling rules in a scaling group and returns information about the scaling rules.

DetachAlbServerGroups.title: Remove one or more ALB server groups
DetachAlbServerGroups.summary: Removes one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups from a scaling group.

DetachDBInstances.title: Remove one or more RDS instances
DetachDBInstances.summary: Removes one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances.

DetachInstances.title: Remove one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
DetachInstances.summary: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group.

DetachLoadBalancers.title: Remove one or more load balancing instances
DetachLoadBalancers.summary: Removes one or more load balancing instances.

DetachServerGroups.title: Remove one or more load balancing server groups
DetachServerGroups.summary: Removes one or more load balancing server groups from a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB).

DetachVServerGroups.title: DetachVServerGroups
DetachVServerGroups.summary: Removes one or more virtual server groups.

EnterStandby.title: Set ECS instances in a scaling group to the standby state
EnterStandby.summary: Sets ECS instances in a scaling group to the standby state.

ExitStandby.title: Transition standby instances to running state
ExitStandby.summary: Transitions ECS instances in standby state within a scaling group to the running state.

ListTagKeys.title: Query tag keys of Auto Scaling resources
ListTagKeys.summary: Queries the list of tag keys for Auto Scaling resources.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the labels that are attached to one or more elastic scaling resources.

ListTagValues.title: Query tag values of Auto Scaling resources by tag key
ListTagValues.summary: Queries the tag values that correspond to a tag key of Auto Scaling resources.

ModifyAlertConfiguration.title: ModifyAlertConfiguration
ModifyAlertConfiguration.summary: When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications through SMS or email. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the ModifyAlertConfiguration operation to set the scaling activity statuses for which SMS and email notifications are sent in a scaling group. This helps you stay informed about scaling activity changes and respond promptly to improve scaling efficiency.

ModifyEciScalingConfiguration.title: Modify a scaling configuration
ModifyEciScalingConfiguration.summary: Modifies a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) type.

ModifyInstanceAttribute.title: Modify partial information of an ECS instance in a scaling group
ModifyInstanceAttribute.summary: Modifies partial information of an ECS instance in a scaling group by calling the ModifyInstanceAttribute API. Currently, only the lifecycle management property of instances manually added to a scaling group can be modified, allowing Auto Scaling to manage ECS instances in the scaling group more flexibly.

ModifyLifecycleHook.title: Modify a lifecycle hook
ModifyLifecycleHook.summary: Modifies the information of a lifecycle hook.

ModifyNotificationConfiguration.title: Modify a notification for Auto Scaling events and resource changes
ModifyNotificationConfiguration.summary: Modifies a notification for Auto Scaling events and resource changes.

ModifyScalingConfiguration.title: ModifyScalingConfiguration
ModifyScalingConfiguration.summary: Modifies an ECS-type scaling configuration (the ECS instance template used for scale-out) by calling the ModifyScalingConfiguration API if the current scaling configuration does not meet your business requirements.

ModifyScheduledTask.title: Modify a scheduled task
ModifyScheduledTask.summary: Modifies the information of a scheduled task.

RebalanceInstances.title: Rebalance ECS instance distribution
RebalanceInstances.summary: Rebalances the distribution of ECS instances across zones in a multi-zone scaling group.

RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.title: Extend the wait time after a lifecycle hook is triggered
RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.summary: Extends the wait time for an ECS instance that is suspended after a lifecycle hook is triggered.

RemoveInstances.title: Remove one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
RemoveInstances.summary: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group.

ResumeInstanceRefresh.title: ResumeInstanceRefresh
ResumeInstanceRefresh.summary: Resumes an instance refresh task that is in the paused state.

ResumeProcesses.title: Resume paused scaling processes in a scaling group
ResumeProcesses.summary: Resumes paused scaling processes in a scaling group.

RollbackInstanceRefresh.title: Roll back an instance refresh task
RollbackInstanceRefresh.summary: Rolls back an instance refresh task during execution. If the desired configuration no longer meets your requirements during an instance refresh task, you can call this operation to roll back the task. During the rollback, the system creates new instances based on the currently active configuration of the scaling group to replace instances that were created based on the desired configuration.

ScaleWithAdjustment.title: Trigger elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule
ScaleWithAdjustment.summary: Triggers elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule.

SetGroupDeletionProtection.title: Enable or disable deletion protection for a scaling group
SetGroupDeletionProtection.summary: Enables or disables deletion protection for a scaling group.

SetInstanceHealth.title: Set the health status of an ECS instance in a scaling group
SetInstanceHealth.summary: Sets the health status of an ECS instance in a scaling group.

SetInstancesProtection.title: Start or stop protection for ECS instances in a scaling group
SetInstancesProtection.summary: Starts or stops protection for one or more ECS instances in a scaling group.

StartInstanceRefresh.title: StartInstanceRefresh
StartInstanceRefresh.summary: Starts an instance refresh task in a scaling group to apply a new scaling configuration or update the image of instances in the scaling group.

SuspendInstanceRefresh.title: SuspendInstanceRefresh
SuspendInstanceRefresh.summary: Pauses an instance refresh task during execution. If you suspect that the configuration has issues but are not sure whether a rollback is needed, you can call this operation to pause the instance refresh task and check whether the configuration is correct.

SuspendProcesses.title: Suspend specified scaling processes in a scaling group
SuspendProcesses.summary: Suspends specified scaling processes in a scaling group.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Creates and binds tags to a specified list of Auto Scaling resources.

UntagResources.title: Unbind tags from specified Auto Scaling resources
UntagResources.summary: After a tag is unbound, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other resources.

VerifyAuthentication.title: Check whether Auto Scaling is authorized to operate on ECS resources
VerifyAuthentication.summary: Checks whether Auto Scaling is authorized to operate on ECS resources.

VerifyUser.title: Verify whether Auto Scaling is activated
VerifyUser.summary: Verifies whether Auto Scaling is activated.
